summary: No new criminal case was filed at the Fairbanks, Nenana, Delta Junction or Healy courts between Thursday evening and early Friday. Thirteen cases carry a hearing in those courts on Friday, among them a bail hearing in a first-degree burglary case and a status hearing in the Sarten murder case. Troopers reported one incident in the area overnight, a collision on the Richardson Highway near Delta Junction, and the Fairbanks city police bulletin listed nothing for Friday as of 3:52 a.m. The weekly state court report refreshed to cover Oct. 30 through Nov. 5 and lists 34 Fairbanks cases, two at Delta Junction and none at Nenana or Healy; five cases the Fairbanks court opened on Nov. 5 are not in it.

entries.title: First-degree burglary charge: Trenton Allen Rix
body: Trenton Allen Rix is charged with burglary in the first degree — an unlawful entry in which someone is injured or injury is attempted — a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years.

He is also charged with theft in the fourth degree, taking property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor, and with violating the conditions of release on a felony case, a Class A misdemeanor. None of the three counts is recorded as domestic violence related.
All three offenses are recorded as occurring Nov. 2 in Fairbanks. The case was filed Nov. 3 and he was arraigned the same day.
Case 4FA-26-02223CR, before Judge Thomas Temple. A bail hearing on the prosecutor’s application for bail review is set for 9:15 a.m. Nov. 6.

entries.title: Murder case status hearing: Cedar Mae Sarten
body: A status hearing in the case against Cedar Mae Sarten is set for 9 a.m. Nov. 6 in Fairbanks Superior Court before Judge Brent Bennett.

A Fairbanks jury found Sarten guilty in May of murder in the first degree in the death of her five-year-old son. Sentencing is set for Jan. 29, 2027. A sentencing date that had been calendared for Nov. 6 is recorded as reset.

entries.title: Collision investigated on the Richardson Highway near Delta Junction
body: Alaska State Troopers responded to a motor vehicle collision near mile 274 of the Richardson Highway, outside Delta Junction, on Nov. 5 at about 11:18 p.m.
Troopers say the investigation is continuing. No injuries, charges or names are given in the trooper report.
